title: Stable Update & Bonsai Fit
changes: Fixed the compact dashboard bonsai artwork being cut off on narrow mobile layouts.
Gave the bonsai sprite a wider visual frame while keeping the overall progress card compact.
Removed the stray Tap for status helper text that could appear up in the page header.
Kept the entire bonsai card tappable to open the existing condition explanation.
Added a release self-heal that pins the service-worker registration to v11.8.36 after the older app shell registers.
Updates the visible page title and version badge to the current release on every load.
Retained Theatre Normal, Slow and Extra slow synchronized playback controls.
Retained the Reading-from-Meaning wrong-answer review pause.
Bumped shell and image caches to v11.8.36.
